proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka's Sharh-i Nazm al-Durr alters a line of Ibn al-Farid to replace the Companions and Followers with his children and the holy Imams, in what MK says would seem to be specifically Shiʿi fashion.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, author of Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr
mediation.note: A doctrinal work, not addressed to a judge; the duress rule counts a work as evidence of what he held.
We have the work only as MK summarises or translates it; most of the lettrist works are unedited, so MK's paraphrase cannot be checked against a printed text.
